card.name: Small prepositions after changes or episodes
card.fires_on: The small word "in" (sometimes "on") right after a noun like "changes", "episodes" or "lab", where it begins a phrase saying what is affected. Seen mostly in antidepressant warning text, e.g. "unusual changes in behavior".

modes.label: changes in behavior
modes.description: "in" after "unusual changes" in antidepressant monitoring warnings.
modes.example: or unusual changes<< in>> behavior, whether or not they are taking

modes.label: episodes in people
modes.description: "in" after a reaction noun, leading to a group of susceptible people.
modes.example: less severe asthmatic episodes<< in>> certain susceptible people.

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted tokens and the suppressed "I" tokens beyond a push away from starting a new sentence.
card.plain: It fires on the little word "in" in phrases like "changes in behavior", just before the thing that changed is named.
